name: Coinmarketcap - current data for selected coins
description:
Fetches cryptocurrency data from CoinMarketCap API and filters it using specified cryptocurrencies.

The data output includes : name, symbol, rank, price, % price change (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, 60d, 90d), market cap, fully diluted market cap, max supply, circulating supply, % market cap dominance, volume 24h, and time of last update.

The tool requires an API key.

In configuration, set the list of cryptocurrencies you are interested in, as well as the fiat currency to convert to.
